data.body: `LAYER_NAME` (`aws-durable-execution-sdk-java-otel-plugin`) is a single, fixed-name, multi-region AWS resource, but the concurrency group is keyed by `github.sha`. A release-triggered run (sha of the release tag) and a `workflow_dispatch` run from `main` (current HEAD sha) — or two releases published close together — get different `github.sha` values and therefore run concurrently. Both would independently run `list-layer-versions` → `publish-layer-version` → `add-layer-version-permission` against the same layer name/regions at the same time; each can observe "no existing version with this description" before either publishes, so both can call `publish-layer-version`, creating duplicate versions with the same `Description`, and the reuse-lookup only ever reads the first matching line — breaking the idempotency invariant the script is built around. Use a static group name (e.g. `lambda-layer-publish`) so all publish runs against this shared layer are serialized.
